answers.reasoning: create's Object.assign(useBoundStore, api) copies vanilla store methods onto the hook function itself.
useSyncExternalStore's third arg is the server-snapshot getter: selector applied to getInitialState().
Modern zustand delegates zombie-child handling to useSyncExternalStore itself; the old manual useReducer/ref recheck was removed.
getState() just reads current state with no subscription, so the component never re-renders on later set() calls by itself.
useSyncExternalStore reruns the selector via getSnapshot and bails out unless Object.is says the selected slice changed.
